project.name: AI Supervisor by Bijli Wala Aya
project.type: Mobile-first web app (PWA), 3 roles in one app: Customer, Technician, Admin
project.one_line: An AI senior supervisor for home-appliance (Split AC) repair: helps customers first, then guides technicians step by step with physics-based checks, live camera + voice AI, official wiring diagrams, safety gates and transparent reports.
target_users: Customers in Tier-2/Tier-3 Indian cities (e.g., Ayodhya) — Hindi-first, low tech comfort, budget-conscious
Ground-level AC technicians — busy hands, outdoor sunlight, cheap Android phones, need big buttons and voice
Admin / company owner — manages knowledge base and AI accuracy
project.language: Hindi primary (Devanagari) with small English sub-labels; all numbers and units in English digits
project.must_feel: Trustworthy, simple, fast, premium but friendly — same family as the existing Bijli Wala Aya app

design_system.brand_match: Match existing Bijli Wala Aya app (bijliwalaa.com) exactly

typography.caption: 12px / 500
typography.reading_numbers: 28px / 700 tabular figures (for live readings like PSI, Amp, Volt)

design_system.elevation: Soft shadows (0 4px 16px rgba(17,24,39,0.06)); modals with blurred backdrop (glass effect)
design_system.spacing: 8px grid; screen padding 16px; min touch target 48x48px
design_system.icons: Rounded line icons (Lucide style); 3D illustrated appliance images for service tiles
design_system.motion: Subtle: 150–250ms ease-out; AI voice waveform animation; pulsing mic while listening
design_system.accessibility: WCAG AA contrast, never color-only status (always icon + text), large text option, works in bright sunlight, dark mode toggle

global_components.name: Top header
global_components.spec: Avatar circle (orange), greeting 'नमस्ते, {name}', city chip with location pin (e.g., 'अयोध्या'), icons: search, notification bell with badge, dark-mode toggle

global_components.name: Bottom navigation (role-based)
global_components.spec: 5 items with center floating circular yellow button; active item yellow pill highlight

global_components.name: AI Assistant FAB
global_components.spec: Floating circular button with sparkle + mic icon, blue AI accent ring, label 'AI से पूछें'

global_components.name: Confidence badge
global_components.spec: Pill with % and label: ≥75 green 'भरोसा ज़्यादा', 50–74 amber 'और जाँचें', <50 red 'पक्का नहीं'

global_components.name: Locked action chip
global_components.spec: Grey chip with lock icon 🔒 + short reason, e.g., 'Gas भरना लॉक – पहले leak test + vacuum'; tap opens bottom sheet explaining why

global_components.name: Safety banner
global_components.spec: Red/amber full-width banner with ⚡ icon for high-voltage/high-pressure steps

global_components.name: Reading input card
global_components.spec: Big number field with unit (PSI, A, V, °C), +/− steppers, mic button to speak value, normal-range hint below in small text, status dot (green/amber/red)

global_components.name: Stepper
global_components.spec: Horizontal progress bar with step numbers 1–11 at top + current step title; completed = green check, locked = grey lock

global_components.name: Evidence photo tile
global_components.spec: Square thumbnail with label (Before/After/Nameplate/Voltage), timestamp, retake icon

global_components.name: AI message bubble
global_components.spec: Blue-tinted bubble with small 'AI Supervisor' label, speaker icon to play voice, optional evidence chips (e.g., 'Superheat 18K', 'Amp 62%')

global_components.name: Empty / error / offline states
global_components.spec: Friendly illustration + Hindi message + retry button; offline banner 'नेटवर्क कमज़ोर – rules वाले सुझाव दिख रहे हैं'

elements: Bijli Wala Aya logo + 'AI Supervisor' wordmark with sparkle
Tagline: 'हर repair, सही जाँच के साथ'
3 large role cards with icons: 'मैं ग्राहक हूँ', 'मैं Technician हूँ', 'Admin'
Demo mode chip at bottom: 'Demo देखें'

auth.title: WhatsApp OTP login (bottom sheet)
elements: Phone icon tile (yellow)
'Welcome Back' / 'WhatsApp नंबर डालें'
+91 field
Get OTP primary button
Terms & Privacy links

customer.title: Customer Home
elements: Top header with city chip
Hero AI card (blue-yellow gradient): 'अपनी समस्या बोलिए, AI तुरंत मदद करेगा' + big mic button + 'Photo भेजें' + 'Chat करें'
My AC card: brand logo, 'LG 1.5 Ton Inverter • R32', last service date, warranty chip '45 दिन warranty – 32 दिन बचे'
Quick problem chips: 'ठंडा नहीं कर रहा', 'पानी टपक रहा', 'आवाज़ आ रही', 'Error code', 'Bill ज़्यादा', 'बार-बार trip'
Select Service grid (3D images): AC, Washing Machine, Fridge, TV, RO, Geyser (only AC active, others 'जल्द आ रहा')
Bottom nav: Home, My Bookings, [center: AI FAB], Bill Calculator, Profile

customer.title: AI Chat (customer)
elements: Header: 'AI Supervisor' with green online dot + 'Voice call' icon
Memory card at top (collapsible): 'पिछली बार (12 Nov): gas कम थी, flare leak ठीक किया गया'
Conversation: user bubbles (white), AI bubbles (blue tint) with speaker icon
AI suggests safe self-checks as checklist cards: 'Remote Cool mode पर है?', 'Filter साफ़ है?', 'MCB ON है?' each with ✅/❌ buttons
Inline explainer card: 'R32 gas क्या है? असली बनाम लोकल gas' with simple icon
Composer: text field, mic button (large), camera/photo button, send
When unresolved: AI action card 'Technician बुक करें' with issue summary, urgency chip, location chip and 'Book करें' primary button

customer.title: AI Voice Call (full screen, like a real phone call)
elements: Dark gradient background, large animated AI avatar orb with voice waveform
Caller label 'Bijli Wala Aya – AI Supervisor', call timer
Live captions (Hindi) scrolling at bottom
Buttons: mute, speaker, camera on/off (to show AC), end call (red)
Small chip 'AI बात समझ रहा है…' while thinking

customer.title: Booking Confirmed
elements: Success check animation
Technician card: photo, name 'Kartik', rating, skills chips 'AC Expert', distance '2.4 km'
Job ID, problem summary, address with map thumbnail
Status timeline: Booked → Technician assigned → On the way → Started → Completed
Buttons: 'Technician को call करें', 'AI से बात करें'

customer.title: Consent + Quotation approval
elements: Section 'काम से पहले शर्तें' with 3 plain-Hindi bullet cards: जाँच charge ₹X; gas सिर्फ़ leak test + vacuum के बाद; gas के बाद compressor कमज़ोर निकला तो खर्च अलग
Quotation table: items (Leak repair, R32 gas by weight, Labour), price, total — with AI 'क्यों?' info icons
AI explanation card in simple Hindi with evidence chips (Voltage 228V ✅, Superheat 18K ⚠)
Checkbox 'मैं सहमत हूँ' + primary 'Approve करें' + secondary 'सवाल पूछें'

customer.title: Job Report & Feedback
elements: OTP display card for closing job
Report: appliance, before/after readings side-by-side (green improvements), photos grid, work done, parts with brand + warranty, total cost, technician, AI confidence
Installation quality badges (if installation): Copper 0.8mm ✅, Insulation 13mm ✅, Vacuum 500 micron ✅
Warranty card '45 दिन – till 3 Jan 2027'
Rating stars + 'Share report' + 'Download PDF'

customer.title: Bill & Star Rating Calculator
elements: Inputs: label units (kWh/year), daily hours, days, ₹ per unit
Result card: monthly + yearly bill big numbers
Compare 3-star vs 5-star bar chart + payback years
Tip chips: '24°C पर चलाएँ', 'Filter हर 2 हफ़्ते साफ़ करें'

technician.title: Technician Home – Leads
elements: Header with online/offline toggle (big switch), today's earnings chip
New lead card with yellow glow: customer area, distance, problem chips, AI pre-diagnosis 'संभावना: Gas कम (60%)', Accept/Reject buttons
Today's jobs list with status chips
Bottom nav: Leads, My Jobs, [center: Live AI Supervisor FAB], Tools, Profile

technician.title: Job Workflow Stepper (MAIN DEMO SCREEN)
technician.layout: Top: stepper progress (11 steps) + job summary chip; Middle: current step card; Bottom: sticky bar with 'Live AI' button and 'अगला step' primary button

steps.name: Customer consent
steps.ui: Status card: 'ग्राहक ने शर्तें मान लीं ✅ 10:42 AM'

steps.name: Safety gate
steps.ui: Checklist with large toggles: Power OFF, MCB OFF, Capacitor discharged, Gloves, No water near PCB, Inverter DC bus <36V; next steps locked until all ticked

steps.name: Appliance
steps.ui: 'Nameplate की photo लें' camera card → auto-filled fields with confidence dots (Brand, Model, Ton, Inverter, Refrigerant, Rated Amp); editable

steps.name: Problem
steps.ui: Large selectable chips with icons: No cooling, Less cooling, Water leak, Noise, Error code, Trip, Service

steps.name: Field checks (no gauge yet)
steps.ui: Touch/Listen checklist: suction pipe ठंडा?, ice कहाँ?, compressor आवाज़?, बदबू? + note 'Gauge अभी नहीं – पहले clamp meter'

steps.name: Readings
steps.ui: Reading input cards grid: Voltage (load), Amp, Suction PSI, Discharge PSI, Suction pipe °C, Liquid pipe °C, Grill/Room/Outdoor °C; Inverter test-mode toggle; mic button to speak values; gauge warning chip

steps.name: Rules + AI Diagnosis
steps.ui: Physics card (calculated: Superheat 18K, Subcooling 2K, Amp ratio 62%) + diagnosis list with confidence badges + reasoning accordion + locked actions chips (e.g., 'Gas भरना 🔒', 'Capacitor बदलना 🔒 – µF ठीक है')

steps.name: Guided steps
steps.ui: Vertical step list; each step card: instruction (Hindi), safety level icon, expected reading, ✅/❌ buttons, 'Diagram देखें', 'AI से पूछें'

steps.name: Quotation
steps.ui: Parts + labour builder, sends to customer, waiting state 'ग्राहक approval का इंतज़ार'

steps.name: After readings & evidence
steps.ui: Before vs After comparison cards, after photos, voltage proof photo; low-voltage warning card 'Supply issue – ग्राहक को समझाएँ' button

steps.name: Close & Feedback
steps.ui: OTP input, auto report preview, 'AI सही था?' thumbs up/down + actual fault dropdown

technician.title: Live AI Supervisor (camera + voice) — HERO SCREEN
elements: Full-screen live camera view of the AC/PCB
Top overlay: job chip 'LG 1.5T • R32', recording dot, connection quality
AI detection overlays: rounded boxes with labels (e.g., 'Service valve', 'Capacitor 35+2.5µF', 'Burnt mark?') and confidence
Bottom glass panel: animated AI voice orb + live Hindi captions of both technician and AI
Auto-captured reading chips sliding in: 'Suction 85 PSI saved ✅'
Quick actions: 'Photo लें', 'Diagram', 'Rules चलाएँ', 'Torch', mute, end
Safety banner appears when AI detects high-voltage area

technician.title: Official Wiring Diagram Viewer
elements: Badge 'Official • LG Service Manual' (or red state 'Official diagram उपलब्ध नहीं – Admin से अपलोड कराएँ' with no generated diagram)
Zoomable diagram image
Color legend list: wire color swatch → terminal → function (L, N, Earth, C/S/R, Fan, Sensor)
Tap-to-mark pins, confidence badge, 'AI redraw – verify' watermark toggle

technician.title: Technician Calculators
elements: Grid of tool cards: PT / Superheat / Subcooling, Capacitor check, Winding check (C-S-R / U-V-W), Wire & MCB advisor, Bill calculator, Ton finder
Each tool screen: inputs, big result with ✅/❌, explanation in Hindi, 'Job में save करें'

technician.title: 'ग्राहक को समझाओ' (Dispute assist) bottom sheet
elements: AI generated simple explanation with readings/photos as proof
Play voice in Hindi button, Share to customer, 'Support से जोड़ें' button
Calm tone illustration

admin.title: Admin Dashboard
elements: KPI cards: Total jobs, Completed, AI accuracy %, Avg time per job, 'Gas बचाई (jobs)', Blocked wrong actions
Line chart: AI accuracy over time; bar chart: accuracy by fault type
Recent feedback table: job, AI prediction, actual, ✅/❌, technician
Desktop-responsive layout with left sidebar (Dashboard, Knowledge, Reference values, Technicians, Jobs)

admin.title: Knowledge Base Manager
elements: Upload card: brand, model pattern, doc type (Wiring / Error codes / Manual), file drop zone, verified toggle
Table of docs with brand logos, type chips, verified badge, actions
Error code editor: brand, code, meaning, causes, checks, source link

admin.title: Reference Values Editor
elements: Grouped list: Refrigerant PT, Pressure ranges, Amp ranges, Wire/MCB table, Capacitor tolerance
Each row: value, unit, source link, 'Verified' toggle (unverified rows show amber 'typical value')

key_flows_to_prototype: Customer: Home → mic 'AC ठंडा नहीं कर रहा' → AI chat self-checks → Book technician → Booking confirmed

Technician: Lead accept → Stepper safety → Nameplate photo auto-fill → Readings → Diagnosis with locked 'Gas भरना' → Live AI Supervisor camera → Diagram → Quotation → After readings → OTP close → Feedback
Customer: Consent & quotation approve → Report + warranty
Admin: Upload diagram → Dashboard accuracy update

sample_content.appliance: LG 1.5 Ton Inverter Split AC, R32
sample_content.diagnosis_example: Gas कम / leak की संभावना – 84% भरोसा। पहले leak ढूँढें, gas भरना अभी लॉक है।

output_requirements: Generate ALL screens listed above as high-fidelity mobile screens (390x844), plus Admin screens in desktop (1440x900) and mobile
Use the exact design_system colors, Inter + Noto Sans Devanagari fonts, 16px radius cards, pill chips, yellow primary buttons
Hindi-first copy exactly as given; realistic Indian context (₹, Ayodhya, Indian brands LG/Daikin/Voltas)
Show states: loading, empty, error, offline, locked action, success
Include light and dark mode variants for Customer Home and Live AI Supervisor
Keep consistent component styles across all screens so it can be exported as one design system
